claims.summary: Snag: 'oscillation trap' near 30% and 50% thresholds could toggle shorten-rest vs extend-rest, blocking PI steady-state.
claims.disposition: Grounded core, refined mechanism (not domesticated). Source L18-28 is a piecewise-constant step with NO hysteresis (30/40/50 bands), so jitter at any boundary toggles rest_secs -> real. But: boundary toggles are shorten<->base at 30% and extend<->base at 50%; a direct shorten<->extend swing needs crossing the whole 30->40-50 span. Evaluated once per burst-rest cycle (L217) on smoothed fill_pct, damping 'rapid'. Pinned by new regression.
